import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Ensure the dataset 'dogs_zurich.csv' is in a 'data' subdirectory.")
    exit()

# --- Data Cleaning and Preparation ---

# Filter for the most recent complete year available in the dataset for a stable "top breeds" list
# Let's assume the latest full year is 2023, as 2024/2025 might be incomplete/forecast data
latest_full_year = 2023
df_filtered = df[df['StichtagDatJahr'] <= latest_full_year].copy()

# Clean up breed names: strip whitespace and handle common inconsistencies
df_filtered['Rasse1Text'] = df_filtered['Rasse1Text'].str.strip()

# Identify the top 10 most popular breeds based on their total count up to the latest full year
top_10_breeds = df_filtered['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index

# Filter the dataset to include only records for these top 10 breeds
df_top_breeds = df_filtered[df_filtered['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_10_breeds)]

# Group by year and breed to get the annual count for each of the top breeds
yearly_counts = df_top_breeds.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text']).size().reset_index(name='count')

# --- Visualization ---

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", rc={"axes.edgecolor": ".8", "xtick.color": ".3", "ytick.color": ".3"})
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Create the line plot
ax = sns.lineplot(
    data=yearly_counts,
    x='StichtagDatJahr',
    y='count',
    hue='Rasse1Text',
    palette='viridis', # Using a colorblind-friendly and visually distinct palette
    linewidth=2.5,
    marker='o',
    markersize=5
)

# --- Customization and Labeling ---

# Set the title and axis labels with more descriptive text
plt.title(f'Popularity Trends of Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (until {latest_full_year})', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, labelpad=15)
plt.ylabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12, labelpad=15)

# Improve tick formatting
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MaxNLocator(integer=True)) # Ensure x-axis ticks are integers
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

# Customize the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(
    handles=handles,
    labels=labels,
    title='Dog Breed',
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 1),
    loc='upper left',
    borderaxespad=0.,
    fontsize=10,
    title_fontsize=12
)

# Add a subtle grid
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)

# Remove top and right spines for a cleaner look
sns.despine(left=True, bottom=True)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1]) # Adjust rect to make space for the legend

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
